task.question: Which former French prime minister (in office 1997–2002) died on 22 March 2026?
task.evidence: 22 March – Lionel Jospin, 88, prime minister (1997–2002), minister of national education (1988–1992), and member of the Constitutional Council (2015–2019).

answer:
The former French prime minister who served from 1997 to 2002 and died on March 22, 2026, is Lionel Jospin. 

FINAL: Lionel Jospin

[Lionel Jospin]
Lionel Robert Jospin (French: [ljɔnɛl ʁɔbɛʁ ʒɔspɛ̃]; 12 July 1937 – 22 March 2026) was a French politician who served as Prime Minister of France from 1997 to 2002. Jospin was first secretary of the Socialist Party from 1995 to 1997 and the party's candidate for president in the 1995 and 2002 elections. In 1995, he was narrowly defeated in the seco
As a member of the National Assembly, Jospin served first as a representative of Paris (1978–86), and then of Haute-Garonne département (1986–88). He lost his seat in the National Assembly in the Socialists' landslide defeat in the 1993 legislative election and announced his political retirement. In 1993, Jospin was appointed ministre plénipotentia
Jospin served as prime minister during France's third "cohabitation" government under President Chirac from 1997 to 2002. Despite his previous image as a rigid socialist, Jospin sold state-owned enterprises and lowered the VAT, income tax and company tax rates.
Many left-wing candidates contested the election, gaining small percentages of the vote in the first ballot that reduced Jospin's support.
